![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Update the expected order of the IDs in the assertions to match the lexicographically sorted arrays.

```suggestion
    expect(readbackJson.next_blocking_engineering_issues.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual([
      'official_scoring_and_release_scope_gate',
      'phase_b2_remote_mutation_approval',
      'rights_display_policy_approval',
      'source_visual_receipt_and_figure_asset_acceptance',
    ]);
    expect(readbackJson.next_usage_driven_visual_work.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual([
      'convert_accepted_visuals_into_student_display_assets',
      'human_review_source_figure_candidates',
      'promote_visual_blocked_smoke_hits_to_priority_queue',
      'resume_vlm_candidate_wave_after_explicit_authorization',
    ]);
```

Fixed in 8cd6deaaf: `buildNextUsageDrivenVisualWork` now routes through `sortByIdByteOrder`, so the generated array is strict `id` order: `convert_accepted_visuals_into_student_display_assets`, `human_review_source_figure_candidates`, `promote_visual_blocked_smoke_hits_to_priority_queue`, `resume_vlm_candidate_wave_after_explicit_authorization`. Regenerated readback artifacts and reran focused Jest, builder `--check`, `git diff --check`, and preflight.
Fixed in 8cd6deaaf: updated the focused test expectations to match the strict `id` ordering for both generated arrays. The focused Jest suite passes with the regenerated artifacts.
